Triage: lands in `domain:ui` (`content/docs/components/**` reference pages against the `@object-ui/types` zod twins); rationale: class (b) **and** (c) on the three confirmed rows. The contract is cited with its enforcement site — `handlerKeyRefusal` resolves to a `z.custom` arm whose predicate always returns `false` (`zod/tombstone.zod.ts:109-123`), and each of the three rows is matched to the refusal arm that names its key (`disclosure.zod.ts:43`, `:78`, `navigation.zod.ts:115`). These are authoring `## Schema` fences, so the documented key is refused by name the moment a reader copies it. `Bug`.

`priority:p3`, ⛔ not p2: the refusal is **loud and self-explaining** — refused by name with guidance pointing at the node-type spelling (#6124). An author who copies `onValueChange` learns immediately. Contrast #8278 (graded p2 today), where the wrong key is accepted, kept and silently never read. Loud beats silent by a grade.

⭐ Two things this card gets right that this seat is preserving in the grade rather than flattening:

1. It is labelled a **census, not a diagnosis**, and the 3/14 split is honest. The 14 unclassified rows are ⛔ **not** part of this card's admitted claim — at least two of them are known not to be defects (`tree-view.mdx:45`'s `onNodeClick` is in no `handlerKeyRefusal` call; several sit on nested item interfaces whose item-level zod objects were never checked). Whoever takes this does the **classification pass first**; ⛔ do not treat 17 as the defect count.
2. Its own dispatch shape is right — one classification pass then one sweep, the #8125 shape, ⛔ not 17 cards. Grading it as one card ratifies that.

The three-way per-row remedy the card names (delete / annotate `never` as `button-group.mdx:24` does / move to prose as `tooltip.mdx` does) is a per-row editorial call, not a contract decision, so it stays with the dev seat — ⛔ no contract review needed here.

⛔ Out of scope, ⛔ do not fold in: the `pagination.mdx` `currentPage` / `pageSize` / `totalItems` drift the card spotted in passing is a different claim on the same page and was explicitly not chased. It needs its own card if anyone wants it; a rider here would ship an unmeasured change.

⛔ This seat grades and routes only: not claimed, not dispatched, no code.
